consumer_review.full_jd_text: The National Institute of Education invites suitable applications for the position of Research Assistant on a 12-month contract at the English Language and Literature (ELL) Department . Project Title: Enhancing Teacher–AI Collaboration with ALMA (AI Learning Multimodal Assistant) Project Introduction: ALMA (AI Learning Multimodal Assistant) is a video-based assistant with an interactive avatar that listens and speaks with students as they practice their presentations. It is grounded in Learning-as-Design and social semiotic perspectives on assessment. It analyses students' speech, gesture, gaze, facial expression, visuals and text to give real-time formative feedback, and it engages them in dialogue to assess their understanding. ALMA responds to generative AI undermining written assessment, which has increased the need for authentic, process-sensitive alternatives. Oral assessment provides richer evidence of learning but is hard to scale. ALMA makes it more feasible by giving consistent, personalised and diagnostic feedback on features often overlooked, such as pacing, fluency, body language and how well slides match speech. Teachers keep the final judgement and pedagogical decisions. Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree in Computing and Data Sciences Skilled in development of chatbots Interest in Generative AI and Learning Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering and API integration. Proficiency in Python; experience with frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph and FastAPI. Familiarity with Office Tools (PowerPoint, Excel) Experience in academic research, such as conducting literature reviews, collecting and analysing data, and contributing to research papers or reports Responsibilities: Develop ALMA (AI Learning Multimodal Assistant), a speaking and listening AI assistant Test, evaluate and refine the system with students and teachers based on user feedback and study needs. Liaise with students, teachers and team members to coordinate study activities and gather feedback Prepare technical documentation and support deployment of ALMA in classroom and research settings Analyze the research data from the study. Contribute to the dissemination of research findings: conduct literature reviews, prepare academic publications (e.g., conference presentation, paper, book) and research reports Perform other tasks as required by the Principal Investigators Application Applicants (external and internal) will apply via Workday. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Closing Date Closing date for advertisements will be set to 14 calendar days from date of posting. Hiring Institution: NIE

consumer_review.full_jd_text: Nanyang Technological University’s National Centre for Research in Digital Trust (DTC) is a Trust Technology Research Centre to execute a national program to help put Singapore into a strong trust hub. The key objective is to support efforts to create a trusted digital environment for its people and businesses by providing businesses and consumers with greater assurance and confidence as they digitalize. We are looking for a Research Engineer to build LLM-powered AI agents that automate and improve insurance workflows such as underwriting, claims, policy servicing, risk assessment and customer engagement. You will create autonomous and multi-agent systems that read insurance documents, apply policy rules, support human decision-making and execute end-to-end processes safely. Your work will directly strengthen operational efficiency, customer experience, compliance and responsible AI adoption across the insurance value chain. Key Responsibilities: Translate fluently between business and technical contexts, helping stakeholders, engineers and insurance partners understand complex AI, LLM and agentic AI concepts. Conduct research on LLM-powered AI agents and multi-agent systems, translating algorithms, tools and frameworks into working prototypes that demonstrate how research outputs can be productised into new insurance capabilities. Collaborate with Centre researchers to design and develop production-oriented system implementations, supporting key insurance workflows such as underwriting, claims, policy servicing and risk assessment. Design and build agent tools, evaluation frameworks and demonstration environments that enable technology transfer to research partners and showcase the value of LLM-based agentic AI in insurance. Produce and maintain technical documentation, presentations and research papers on AI agent design, evaluation, guardrails and trust mechanisms, helping raise organisational capability in responsible AI and trust technologies for insurance applications. Engage global partners and researchers to track emerging trends in LLMs, agentic AI and InsurTech, and help strengthen Singapore’s thought leadership in trustworthy AI agent systems for the insurance sector. Job Requirements: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; prior research or engineering experience in LLMs and AI agents is preferred. Ability to translate fluently between business and technical contexts, helping stakeholders, engineers and insurance partners understand complex AI, LLM and agentic AI concepts. Strong hands-on experience with large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks and multi-agent system design. Proficiency in Python and common AI/ML tools and frameworks, with experience building production-grade AI applications, APIs, evaluation pipelines and agent orchestration systems. Solid understanding of AI safety, guardrails, model evaluation, monitoring, data privacy, explainability and responsible AI practices in regulated environments. Good knowledge of system platform development, database technologies and software engineering best practices. Experience in insurance, financial services or other regulated domains is preferred, particularly familiarity with applying LLM-based AI agents to underwriting, claims, policy servicing, risk assessment and customer engagement workflows. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Hiring Institution: NTU

Lead solution development for internal and external AI projects, performing research and maintaining AIAP technologies. Plan and execute LADP intakes and update the LADP syllabus. Requirements: We welcome applicants from all disciplines and qualifications — including NITEC, Diploma, and Degree holders — who can demonstrate the following skills: End-to-End Project Delivery: Have a strong portfolio of AI/ML project(s) that showcases ability to deliver solutions from scoping and data analysis through to deployment and documentation. Applied Machine Learning: Possess deep, practical knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, with proven experience applying algorithms to solve problems in areas like NLP, Computer Vision, or on tabular data. Generative AI & LLMs: Hands-on experience building production LLM applications and designing agentic systems: prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (including graph-based retrieval), tool use, state and control flow design, orchestration frameworks, and the tracing, guardrails, and evaluations that make them reliable. Basic knowledge of fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, dataset construction, and evaluation. Problem Scoping & Prioritisation: Proven ability to qualify a use case before development begins, assessing whether the business pain is real, whether the data is approved, representative and current, and whether GenAI is the appropriate tool at all. Comfortable reducing an ambitious business brief to a technical scope that is both useful and deliverable within a fixed timeline, and confident raising the case for changing direction early. Software Engineering Excellence: Demonstrates expert-level Python skills and a strong commitment to Software Engineering best practices, writing code that is clean, modular, and maintainable. AI-Assisted Development: Highly fluent with agentic coding tools, and able to use them to ship at speed across unfamiliar codebases. Equally able to hold engineering judgement at the points that matter, reviewing, rejecting, and rewriting generated code rather than shipping it unexamined. MLOps & Cloud Proficiency: Fluent in the essential MLOps toolkit, including Git, Docker, and CI/CD principles. Have experience building data and model pipelines on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Passionate Mentor: Eager to develop AI talent across the full range, from apprentices to industry professionals learning to build for the first time, and to contribute to AISG Innovation’s collaborative and supportive team culture. Excellent Communicator: Can articulate complex technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences with clarity and confidence. Comfortable guiding learners to build solutions themselves rather than building on their behalf. Lifelong Learner: Possess a strong sense of curiosity and are driven to stay current in the fast-evolving world of artificial intelligence. consumer_review.full_jd_text: Nanyang Technological University, Singapore (NTU Singapore) is a world-class, research-intensive public university dedicated to providing a transformative education, advancing research, and nurturing global leaders. Driven by innovation, excellence, and a commitment to positive global impact, NTU fosters an inclusive and vibrant ecosystem where cutting-edge technology meets education. At the Institute for Pedagogical Innovation, Research and Excellence (InsPIRE) – Education Transformation, we are dedicated to advancing teaching and learning through educational innovation, research and evidence-informed practice. At the heart of our work is the strategic use of AI and learning analytics to deepen our understanding of how students learn, generate actionable insights into learning behaviours and outcomes, and empower educators to make informed pedagogical decisions. By harnessing emerging technologies, educational data and interdisciplinary research, we seek to develop innovative, personalised and inclusive learning experiences that enhance student engagement and success. We are looking for a Research Associate / Research Fellow to provide specialist expertise in AI-driven innovation for teaching and learning, contributing to the advancement of evidence-informed educational practices at NTU. The role will focus on leading and shaping strategic foundational and translational research directions, developing and evaluating innovative applications of AI and learning analytics to improve teaching effectiveness and student learning experiences. The Research Associate / Research Fellow will drive high-impact research initiatives, foster interdisciplinary collaborations, and translate research findings into actionable insights and scalable educational solutions. Applicants for the Research Fellow role should also provide research leadership. Key Responsibilities: (For Research Associate) Demonstrate intellectual and research independence in identifying, shaping and advancing strategic research directions in AI for advancing NTU’s signature pedagogy. (For Research Fellow) Provide intellectual and research leadership in identifying, shaping and advancing strategic research directions in AI for advancing NTU’s signature pedagogy. Apply AI technologies, including generative AI, machine learning and learning analytics, to develop innovative and scalable educational solutions. Develop and implement technical solutions involving AI model integration, AI agents and data-driven applications, where appropriate. Conduct technical experimentation, testing and iterative refinement to optimise the functionality, reliability, usability and educational effectiveness of AI-enabled tools. Integrate technical development with empirical research to ensure that AI innovations are informed by pedagogical principles and supported by robust evidence. Translate research findings and technical innovations into actionable recommendations, reusable AI tools and scalable educational solutions that contribute to teaching and learning improvement. Contribute to knowledge-sharing activities, workshops and strategic initiatives that strengthen institutional capabilities in AI-enhanced teaching and learning. Job Requirements: Masters (for Research Associate) / PhD (for Research Fellow) qualification degree in artificial intelligence, computer science, learning analytics or related field. At least 2 years of relevant hands-on technical experience in AI, machine learning or generative AI application development, including experience in designing, developing, prototyping and evaluating AI-enabled tools or systems. Familiarity with emerging AI technologies, AI agents and analytics in educational settings, pedagogical principles and responsible AI practices, including data privacy, research ethics and AI governance, is highly desirable. Good written and oral communication skills. Proficiency in programming skills with hands-on experience in machine learning frameworks, LLM APIs, and AI application development. Experience with relevant AI development frameworks, software engineering practices and data visualization tools will be advantageous. Competent in analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently conceptualise research studies, formulate research questions, and evaluate AI-enabled educational interventions. Experience in experimental design, learning analytics, human-centered design will be advantageous. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams and deliver high-quality outcomes within project timelines. Research Fellows should also demonstrate prior research leadership. We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Hiring Institution: NTU

consumer_review.full_jd_text: The Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine (LKCMedicine) trains doctors who put patients at the centre of their exemplary care. The School, which offers both undergraduate and graduate programmes, is named after local philanthropist Tan Sri Dato Lee Kong Chian. Established in 2010 by Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, in partnership with Imperial College London, LKCMedicine aims to be a model for innovative medical education and a centre for transformative research. The School’s primary clinical partner is the National Healthcare Group, a leader in public healthcare recognised for the quality of its medical expertise, facilities and teaching. The School is transitioning to an NTU medical school ahead of the 2028 successful conclusion of the NTU-Imperial partnership to set up a Joint Medical School. In August 2024, we welcomed our first intake of the NTU MBBS programme, that has been recently enhanced to include themes like precision medicine and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare, with an expanded scope in the medical humanities. Graduates from the five-year undergraduate medical degree programme will have a strong understanding of the scientific basis of medicine, with an emphasis on technology, data science and the humanities. The MVAIT Lab at LKCMed seeks to hire a Research Associate (RA) who will play a role in pioneering research on medical image processing, medical visual technology and LLM, and the interface of AI algorithms with surgical robotics. The RA will design and implement cutting-edge algorithms and also be actively involved in the development AI tools tailored for different medical domains. These are efforts to bridge the gap between advanced computational framework and practical medical use cases. The tools and framework developed by the RA will be meticulously adapted to meet the needs of clinicians, radiologists, and biologists, assisting them in their daily tasks and pioneering research. Ultimately, this position plays a pivotal role in LKCMed's overarching mission to leverage technology to enhance healthcare outcomes and propel the institution to the forefront of medical advancements. Key Responsibilities: Design and implement AI algorithm models to analyze multimodal medical datasets (including MRI, CT, X-ray, OCT, and ultrasound images) for high-precision medical organ segmentation, 3D modeling research, and intelligent diagnosis. Explore and develop the application of large-scale pre-trained models in medical scenarios, including but not limited to intelligent consultation systems based on large language models and disease management systems utilizing multi-modal large model technologies. Develop, test, and optimize AI software systems for various medical tasks, ensuring their applicability and accuracy in real-world medical environments. Utilize data storage technologies to manage multimodal medical data securely and efficiently, ensuring data privacy while providing high storage capacity to accelerate AI model training and inference. Enhance the visualization capabilities of AI software system outputs using VR/AR equipment and 3D visualization technologies, aiding clinical observations and assisting interns in training and rapid learning. Collaborate with the team to systematically complete research and development tasks, assisting in the development of AI-assisted robotic solutions for surgical procedures, including pre-operative planning and intra-operative guidance. Ensure that all research activities adhere to ethical guidelines and patient data privacy regulations. Stay updated on the latest advancements in medical imaging, image processing, robotics, and large language models, ensuring that the research remains at the forefront of the field. Collaborate with external researchers and interdisciplinary teams (including medical professionals, AI experts, and research professors) to ensure the necessity, professionalism, rationality, and practicality of the research. Write research proposals, grant applications, and contribute to the team's strategic research direction. Mentor and train junior researchers, students, and interns, ensuring they possess the necessary skills and knowledge to contribute effectively to the research. Competencies and Qualification Requirements: Master degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from a prestigious institution. Extensive experience in deep learning, AI, computer vision, 3D reconstruction algorithms, and large-scale Pre-trained Models. A solid research foundation and engineering experience in the AI medical field, proficient in programming languages and frameworks such as Python, C++, Pytorch, Tensorflow, Opencv, and COLMAP. Experience in software system engineering, capable of designing a well-structured system architecture to support the implementation of AI medical software. Proficiency in SQL and other data storage technologies, able to apply them flexibly and effectively in the AI medical field, ensuring data storage performance and security. Experience analyzing and interpreting medical imaging datasets, particularly ophthalmic imaging data, with an understanding of the nuances and peculiarities of such datasets. A deep understanding of ethical considerations, patient data privacy regulations, and other compliance-related aspects of medical research. Ability to collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, including medical professionals, AI experts, and research professors. Proactive and self-driven, capable of developing and managing multiple tasks and projects simultaneously. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in additional languages is a plus. Hiring Institution: LKC

consumer_review.full_jd_text: The School of Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE) at NTU, established in 1981, aims to be a world-leading school in sustainability and the built environment, addressing urbanisation and climate change through research and innovation. Do you want to use the latest artificial intelligence to understand our changing planet? The models will be applied to coastline change, land subsidence, urban expansion and vegetation monitoring. The Research Associate will also have the opportunity to explore emerging directions in machine learning for Earth observation, such as vision–language models, agentic AI and generative models. We provide access to high-performance GPU computing as well as close supervision. Key Responsibilities: Develop deep learning models for satellite image time series and multimodal Earth observation data. Develop next generation geospatial foundation models, such as carbon minimization. Explore emerging methods in machine learning for Earth observation, such as vision–language and multimodal large language models that link satellite data with text, agentic AI workflows that plan and carry out geospatial analyses, and generative (e.g. diffusion) models for data synthesis. Apply the models to coastline change, land subsidence, urban expansion and vegetation monitoring. Build scalable and reproducible processing pipelines on high-performance and cloud computing and maintain open-source code and datasets. Prepare data and reference labels, evaluate models and maintain open-source code. Write papers and reports, present results and support the research group. Job Requirements: Master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, remote sensing, geomatics, civil and environmental engineering or a related field. Knowledge of machine learning and deep learning. Experience with remote sensing or geospatial data; knowledge of SAR interferometry is a plus. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch on Linux/GPU computing; experience with foundation models, vision–language models or AI agents is a plus.
